table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname = case printable when  0  then ltrim(str(item.icode)) + ' Counter Sale'   else CASE WHEN item.localitemname is null Then item.name else item.localitemname end end,  
	packing = item.packingdesc,
	users.username, 
	salecat=max(saleledger.salecatcode),
	saleledger.custcode,
	headerno = saleledger.headerno,
	customercode=(select aliasname from accounts where acccode=saleledger.custcode),
	customer=(select name from accounts where acccode=saleledger.custcode),
	address1=(select address1 from customer where customer.custcode=saleledger.custcode),
	invoicetotal=dbo.fn_getsaleinvtotal(saleledger.saleinvcode),
	headerinvno=max(saleledger.headerinvno),
	saleinvcode=saleledger.saleinvcode, 
	posted=max(saleledger.posted),
	balance=max(saleledger.balance),  
	date=saleledger.date,   
	saleledger.discperc,   
	saleledger.misccharges,   
	saleledger.flatdisc,   
	saleledger.salestax,   
	custcode=saleledger.custcode,   
	remarks=saleledger.remarks,   
	saledetail.icode,   
	saledetail.gcode, 
	cashreceived=max(saleledger.cashreceived),
	custrefno=max(saleledger.custrefno),
	Id        = MAX(saledetail.IDENTITYCOL),  
	godown=(select name from godown where godown.gcode=saledetail.gcode),
	looseqty  = sum(saledetail.looseqty), 
	bonusqty  = sum(saledetail.bonusqty), 
	packqty   = sum(saledetail.packqty), 
	packunits = max(saledetail.packunits), 
	saleprice = saledetail.saleprice, 
	rate      = max(saledetail.rate),
	salestax  = max(saledetail.salestax),   
	PreDiscPerc=max(ROUND( (Saledetail.itemflatdisc / CASE WHEN Saledetail.SalePrice > 0 THEN Saledetail.SalePrice ELSE 1 END) * 100, 2)),
	discperc  = saledetail.discperc, 
	sprice = saleledger.sprice,
	customername='                                  '  ,
	itemflatdisc  = saledetail.itemflatdisc,
	aliasname=item.customicode,
	machinename=',' +  max(saleledger.machinename),
	reprintcounter=max(saleledger.reprintingcounter),
	serverdate=getdate(),
	SalePerson = (SELECT SP.Name FROM SalesMan SP WHERE SP.SalesManCode =  saleledger.SManCode),
	LastReceivedAmt = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(V.Credit) FROM VirtualGL V WHERE V.AccCode = saleledger.CustCode AND V.Date <= saleledger.date AND V.Credit > 0 AND V.Date IN (SELECT MAX(VG.Date) FROM VirtualGL VG WHERE VG.Credit > 0 AND VG.AccCode = saleledger.custcode AND VG.Date <= saleledger.Date)), 0)
FROM 
	saleledgermodified saleledger,   
	saledetailmodified saledetail,  
	item,
	Users 
WHERE 
	( saleledger.saleinvcode = :ra_InvCode ) AND
	( saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode ) AND 
	( saleLedger.SalesManCode = users.userCode ) and
	( saledetail.icode = item.icode )
GROUP BY 
	saleledger.saleinvcode, 
	saleledger.date, 
	saleledger.custcode, 
	saleledger.discperc, 
	saleledger.flatdisc, 
	saleledger.misccharges, 
	saleledger.headerno,
	saleledger.salestax, 
	saleledger.remarks, 
	saleledger.sprice,
	saleledger.SManCode,
	saledetail.icode, 
/*	saledetail.rowgroup,*/
	saledetail.saleprice,
	saledetail.itemflatdisc,
	saledetail.discperc,
	saledetail.gstperc,
	saledetail.unitsalestax,
	saledetail.gcode, 
	item.name,
	item.localitemname,
	item.icode,
	item.printable,
	item.packingdesc,
	item.customicode,
	users.username
ORDER BY 
	MAX(saledetail.IDENTITYCOL)
